articles.title: Bain Capital Crypto leads $110M Variational round at $1.5B valuation
articles.description: Variational raised $110 million at a $1.5 billion valuation to expand Omni’s derivatives markets and increase trading limits.

articles.title: Binance says it won $6.5B worldwide freezing order after hack
articles.description: The court orders permit service via blockchain and support a constantly updating list of 26,000 wallet addresses identified as holding stolen assets, Binance’s lawyers said.

articles.title: Sam Altman says his life is so weird that he’s unfazed by Andrew Garfield portraying him in upcoming movie
articles.description: "It doesn't feel like it's in like the top 10 weirdest things about my life," Altman said.

articles.title: Snapchat now lets developers build AR Lenses with AI assistants like Claude Code and Cursor
articles.description: Lens creators can describe the Lens they want in plain language, and their AI assistant handles the process from start to finish, Snapchat says.

articles.title: Spend management platform Payhawk announces $280M raise, 2B valuation
articles.description: Founded in 2018, Payhawk is an enterprise financial management platform that helps companies track and manage expenses and procurement using AI agents.

articles.title: MARA prices $185M debt offering after $1.1B Bitcoin sale

articles.title: Google’s AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
articles.description: Google's new temporary threads let users have conversations in AI Mode without adding them to their search history or influencing future recommendations.

articles.title: More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked

articles.title: David Ellison says HBO will air critical Elon Musk documentary despite his $1B investment in Skydance
articles.description: Following news of the investment, questions emerged over how Musk's sizable stake in the company might affect Skydance's plans to distribute a documentary that is highly critical of him.

articles.title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
articles.description: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.

articles.title: Polymarket US takes rapid-fire crypto trading format to oil, natural gas
articles.description: Polymarket US said it attracted more than 300,000 traders to its short-duration crypto markets in six weeks and is now expanding the format to energy commodities.

articles.title: Sam Altman warns against a future where AI, not humans, calls the shots
articles.description: Sam Altman and Greg Brockman pushed back against Silicon Valley's growing debate over an AI takeover, while acknowledging the challenges of keeping advanced models under human control.

articles.title: Bitcoin, stocks wobble as Fed’s Waller talks of ‘shock’ 50-point rate hike
articles.description: Bitcoin price action dropped below $63,000 after fresh hawkish comments from the Fed as Nvidia earnings optimism faded.

articles.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
articles.description: Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down last week amid several scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

articles.title: Sony’s updated turntable is an easy entry into the world of vinyl
articles.description: Sony's updated turntable for beginners features automatic playback, USB connectivity, and aptX Adaptive Bluetooth.

articles.title: German judge proposes dropping Movie2k case if operator hands over $2.56 billion in bitcoin
articles.description: Prosecutors estimate the defendant still holds 56,000 BTC, meaning the proposed deal would leave him with roughly $1 billion.

articles.title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears
articles.description: As Hong Kong pushes banks to use AI to combat crypto crime, experts say the technology must detect suspicious transfers without putting customer funds at risk.
